text.tspan: Weekly Report
To:Tom Ulaszek
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Status Report
Date:August 13, 1992
Accomplishments
1.Cleaned up paperwork and did some filing. 8/6/92.
2.Got FALCON030 corrections from Richard Miller and began incorporating them into the
Hardware Specification and Service Guide. 8/6/92.
3.Started new FALCON030 Hard Disk Installation Instructions with all new drawings.
4.Created drawings and completed FALCON030 Hared Disk Installation Instructions. 8/7/92.
5.Sent FALCON030 Hard Disk Installation Instructions to Tom in Taiwan. 8/7/92.
6.Backed up TT030 and ABC386DXII.
7.Finished corrections to FALCON030 Hardware Specification. Started layout and
re-pagination of document. 8/8/92-8/9/92.
8.Printed two copies of final draft revision B FALCON030 Hardware Specification. 8/10/92.
9.Corrected FALCON030 Product Specification Table of Contents and printed two copies.
10.Finished adding corrections to FALCON030 Service Guide. 8/10/92.
11.Sent copies of corrected FALCON030 Hardware Specification and Service Guide to
Richard Miller and Tom in Taiwan. 8/10/92.
12.Started making edits to STBook Specification to create an archive copy in PageStream here
locally at ATX. 8/11/92.
13.Continued to compile list of archived documents on hand at ATX. 8/11/92.
14.Started layout of STBook Specification. 8/12/92.
15.Began new block diagram for STBook Service Guide and Product Specification. 8/12/92.
